description: This file defines the SerialNo class and related functions for managing serial numbers in an ERP system, including validation, status updates, and database interactions.

classes.name: SerialNo
classes.description: Represents a serial number entity with validation, status, and database interaction methods.

methods.name: process_serial_no
methods.description: Processes a stock ledger entry to validate and update serial numbers.

methods.name: validate_serial_no
methods.description: Validates serial numbers against item details and stock ledger entries.

methods.name: update_serial_nos
methods.description: Updates serial numbers based on stock ledger entry details.

methods.name: auto_fetch_serial_number
methods.description: Fetches available serial numbers for an item in a warehouse, optionally considering reservations.

methods.name: get_pos_reserved_serial_nos
methods.description: Retrieves serial numbers reserved in POS transactions for an item in a warehouse.

methods.name: get_delivery_note_serial_no
methods.description: Gets serial numbers associated with a delivery note for an item.

methods.name: update_serial_nos_after_submit
methods.description: Updates serial number references after stock ledger submission.

methods.name: update_maintenance_status
methods.description: Updates maintenance status for serial numbers based on expiry dates.
